newsitem.title: UK: LME copper steadies slightly from 6-week lows.
newsitem.headline: LME copper steadies slightly from 6-week lows.

text.p: COPPER - Claws back slightly from late Tuesday's six-week lows in nervous LME ring trading. Downside pressure showing few signs of easing, targets support at $2,400 a tonne.
ALUMINIUM - Down slightly but underpinned by stocks fall. ZINC - Slips with copper. Targets levels below $1,390. NICKEL - Breaks below $7,200, Inco talks loom. OTHERS - Quiet.
